context: Reference natural implementation: lifecycle selector validation should centralize repeated preflight and bind Optional values at the boundary.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 snippets
checklist.description: Returns coherent Java 17-compatible revised snippets with lifecycle methods, validation helpers, records, and IOException behavior intact.

checklist.name: Centralizes lifecycle preflight
checklist.description: stop, status, and logs share one helper that performs explicit-workflow validation before loading the lifecycle manifest.

checklist.name: Uses Optional terminal at boundary
checklist.description: Uses explicitWorkflow.ifPresent(...) or an equivalent Optional terminal at the boundary instead of passing Optional<Path> to a helper that only inspects presence.

checklist.name: Domain helper accepts Path
checklist.description: The helper that validates the selected workflow accepts Path, not Optional<Path>, so the domain validation is separated from optionality.

checklist.name: Removes isEmpty/get flow
checklist.description: Does not keep Optional.isEmpty() followed by Optional.get() to validate the explicit workflow selector.

checklist.name: Preserves validation behavior
checklist.description: Keeps the missing-workflow message, regular-file validation message, validation-before-manifest-load order, and selectForStop/status/logs behavior; simplifying the redundant exists guard is acceptable when observable behavior is unchanged.

checklist.name: Avoids generic Optional utility
checklist.description: Does not introduce broad Optional helpers, fake collections, or unrelated lifecycle redesign to hide the presence check.
